changes: Implemented all six B-b550 M7 milestone-observability hardening items in packages/main. milestone-status.ts: shared MILESTONE_OBSERVABILITY_DISCLAIMER rendered after each Mode line + exported evidenceIsStaleCovering. command-policy.ts: milestone_status reason now discloses Authority. proofstory.ts/types.ts: optional notApplicableDecision field (hash-stable when absent) + not_applicable_missing_decision + empty_confirmed_milestone_ledger + stale_milestone_evidence DONE-gate diagnostics + confirmMilestoneLedger confirm-time hash re-check. handlers: non-throwing closeout skip + freshness plumbing. New reconciliation smoke + 3 negative-control tests + milestone-status suite wired into npm test. 3 decision docs.
usage: Run  /  — output now carries the observability disclaimer. not_applicable milestone rows require a notApplicableDecision (else a DONE-gate diagnostic under enforce). See docs/requirements/decisions/milestone-{triggered-gate-mode-default-decision,not-applicable-justification,status-done-gate-reconciliation}.md.
expectedOutcome: milestone_status/closeout print an explicit observability-only disclaimer (NOT DONE/Authority/production); the milestone-status suite runs in npm test with new passing negative controls (duplicate rows rejected, empty/all-not_applicable confirmed ledger incomplete, stale-only closeout rejected); confirmMilestoneLedger rejects hash-mismatched confirm; not_applicable requires justification; gate-mode default stays observe (recorded + regression-tested); milestone_status and the DONE gate agree on stale evidence; closeout is not a divergent second gate.
actualTranscript: build (tsc) clean; milestone-status.test.mjs ok; proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke passed; milestone-done-gate-reconciliation-smoke OK (incl un-gameable observe-default pin); milestone_status renders 'Scope: observability only - ... NOT a lifecycle DONE, NOT an Authority verdict, NOT a production-readiness gate'; milestone_status reason discloses Authority; ledgerHash sha256:68173e86 unchanged (hash-backcompat); done_intent_equivalence_check Blocking:no (self-safe under observe). All 4 review lanes passed; 68/68 verificationEvidence covered. Full transcript in evidence/transcript-diff.md.
outcomeDiff: No difference — every reproduced claim (V0-V5) matched expected.
limitations: Gate-mode default deliberately stays observe (recorded decision, not a flip); per-trigger enforce is deferred to a future story. not_applicable justification field is optional/migration-safe (legacy confirmed ledgers keep their hash), not retroactively enforced. Reconciliation tightening is non-blocking under the default observe mode; only enforce-mode projects get hard blocking.
pitfalls: Two auto-drafted PLAN-phase verificationIntents diverged from the deliberate design decisions (demanded a 'Disclaimer:' literal vs the chosen 'Scope: observability only' line; a hard-throw the design intentionally avoided). The evidence-binding step caught it; rather than fake evidence or bend sound tested code, rolled back DEV->PLAN and corrected the intents to truthfully verify the delivered behavior (lane counts preserved so the milestone-ledger refs stayed valid). Also: CHK-004 uncovered a REAL gap (confirmed-but-empty ledger vacuously passed DONE) now guarded. REVIEW quality lane caught a doc that promised a nonexistent regression test — fixed by adding a real un-gameable test (exports configuredProofStoryMode, fails if the observe fallback is flipped). Hash-backcompat is the critical invariant: the optional field must be omitted from the hash when absent.
